name: Wireless Dome IP Security Camera System - 4 Camera, Outdoor, Full HD 1080p, 1TB Storage, Night Vision
description: Oculur Wireless Dome IP Security Camera System - 4 Camera, Outdoor, Full HD 1080p, 1TB Storage, Night VisionThis is our smaller wireless security camera system best suited for applications with smaller square footage. If you need a system for bigger environments please look at our 8 channel wireless camera system.Our wireless camera system includes 4 WIFI cameras that connect to your existing wireless network and then to the recorder. The recorder is not wireless and must be hardwired to your network. The cameras still need power from either a wall outlet or a PoE injector/switch. The Oculur X2DFW has a built in scan function much like a laptop and can search for wireless networks in the area. Wireless cameras can still experience video fragmentation even when signal conditions are ideal. For that reason we recommend using hard wired cameras in critical environments. With that said wireless cameras can be an easy way to add visibility to areas where cabling is difficult or expensive. The only thing needed is a power source and an existing wireless network. The recorder has a 4 port built in PoE switch and can also accept hard wired cameras. If you need a custom quote please contact our sales team. You can expect about a week worth of video when recorder on motion with average amounts of movement.This is a high quality wireless system that is more reliable than consumer grade WIFI cameras. You have the full functionality of a commercial grade camera with the flexibility of a wireless camera. Also included is a 3 year warranty and unlimited technical support for setting up remote access, recording schedules, and alerts.Bundled Items:4x Oculur X2DFW Wireless Cameras1x Oculur XNR4-1 4-Channel NVR1x 1TB HDD Storage included.Key features of the SystemWireless Camera System4x IP Cameras1x Network Video Recorder2MPIR Range up to 100ftWeatherproof, Vandal Proof4 Channel Up to 6MP Recording1x SATA HDD SupportKey features Oculur X2DFW2.1MP, 1920x1080@25fps2.8mm fixed lensNight Vision up to 100ft3-Axis rotateOn board...
